title: Create planning loop background job
userStory: As a developer, I want a dedicated background job type for planning loops so that headless planning can run asynchronously.
acceptanceCriteria: New job type: ralph-planning in job queue system
Job executes planning-agent prompt against task context
Job can produce: updated plan, questions for user, or 'ready' signal
Job stores iteration count and history on task
Job respects planning-agent.md prompt structure from ralph-local-team
Multiple iterations supported (loop continues only when user triggers)
Job results displayed to user for review before next action
